01

Log everyday spending

Add a name, amount, date, category and payment method. Edit or delete entries from the expenses table.

02

Make a monthly plan

Set limits for each category. The dashboard shows what you’ve spent and what’s left for the selected month.

03

Learn from your habits

Explore charts and insights, search transactions, and export your data to CSV.

Your records are stored on this browser and device. Clearing browser data removes them. Export a CSV to keep a copy. Sample data is labelled and can be removed with “Clear sample data”.
